configuration.accuracy_contract: Full relative Frobenius AND maximum per-column relative L2 error versus original FP32-input FP64 product; exact-zero input column must remain exactly zero. Rounded-input products independently checked at relative error <=2e-5, except approximate FP32-storage ELL whose original-product quality is measured without certifying its opaque quantizer.
configuration.boundaries: Prepared: resident encodings, compute, crop/unpermute/scatter. Online B: additionally encode/gather changing FP32 B. Online both: also re-encode FP32 A format values with unchanged structure. CUDA graphs repeat one operation eight times, or once when m*k*n>=2^30. Host: pageable FP32 B H2D, uncaptured online-B operation, full FP32 C D2H; four B inputs cycle. CPU format conversion, native plan allocation/A upload/preprocessing/tuning and graph construction are separately measured and charged in reuse amortization; they are not inside device timers.
configuration.memory_scope: Explicit owned CUDA allocations, including original/encoded values, gathered B, intermediate C tiles, workspaces and final output; opaque library/graph allocations and other contexts are additional. Not whole-device peak memory.
configuration.fp32_ell_scope: FP32-storage ELL observed to be approximate; not a strict-FP32 arithmetic reference. Actual original-product errors and full/sample output witnesses retained.
